narrative.details:
Let me guess - you didn't get whatever world-ending, nefarious deed you were doing done in time.  No wait, better still... you dropped it in the sand!  Well, whatever the reason, I do have additional power sources I will sell to you.  This time, however, it will cost you ten, YES TEN Wastewander Water Pouches!

Times are tough all around, adventurer, and power sources don't grow on trees!  Hrm, but what if they did.  Maybe we could MAKE a power source tree...
narrative.objectives: Bring 10 Wastewander Water Pouches to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan in exchange for another power source.
narrative.offerRewardText: Very well, here is another power source. I highly recommend you using it properly this time, unless you are eager to spend ten more water pouches for another water source.
narrative.requestItemsText: Well, have you got the ten water pouches?
